Custom cap details

The Yupoong 6245CM is a hat by Yupoong that you can order with your logo, team name or artwork on it. It comes in 6 colours in one size, so you can mix sizes in a single order and keep one look across your whole team.

Caps are decorated on the front panel. DTF (direct-to-film) prints full-colour logos, photos and gradients with a soft hand-feel; vinyl heat press suits solid-colour text, names and numbers; embroidery gives a raised, stitched finish for logos on this style. Every order gets a proof with the print sized in inches on your garment colour before anything is printed, and production typically takes 7–10 business days after you approve it.

Want to see your logo on it first? Open this hat in Design Studio, place your artwork and send the design with your order. Comparing styles? Browse all hats or all custom apparel.

  1. Send your logo in high quality. Vector (SVG, PDF, AI saved as PDF) or a transparent PNG at 300 DPI at the printed size.
  2. Show the placement. A photo, screenshot or sketch of where the logo goes and roughly how big (e.g. left chest 3.5 in, full back 11 in).
  3. Approve the proof. We send a proof with the print sized in inches on your garment colour before anything is printed.

Low-resolution files may print blurry. Need help? Choose “I need a designer” or create your design in Design Studio.

  • Wait 24 hours before the first wash.
  • Wash inside out in cold water with mild detergent; no bleach or fabric softener.
  • Tumble dry low or hang dry.
  • Do not iron directly on the print; do not dry-clean.
FAQ

Questions about this cap.

Is there a minimum order for the cap?
No. You can order a single piece, and orders above 20 pieces get 5% off the garments and decoration.
Which decoration methods can I choose?
DTF (full colour), Vinyl heat press or Embroidery. DTF is best for full-colour logos and photos; vinyl heat press is best for solid-colour text, names and numbers; embroidery is available for this style.
Where can my logo go?
Caps are decorated on the front only.
How long does production take?
Typically 7–10 business days after you approve your proof. We send the proof with the print sized in inches on your garment colour before anything is printed.
What file should I send?
A vector logo (SVG, PDF or AI saved as PDF) or a transparent PNG at 300 DPI at the printed size. If you do not have one, choose “I need a designer” or create your design in Design Studio.
